The '''Septevorres system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] system with 3 [[Star/Legends|stars]]. It was the site of incident in which an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] drifted into one of the stars because a ''[[Galactic Weekly NewsStack]]'' posting overrode its command control systems.
